description: This file defines a WPF UserControl named TitleBar for a Windows UWP application, managing the custom title bar's appearance, behavior, and system button colors, including event handling for theme changes, window activation, and accessibility settings.

classes.name: TitleBar
classes.description: A custom user control for managing the Windows title bar appearance and behavior, including theme responsiveness and accessibility features.

methods.name: TitleBar
methods.description: Constructor initializing the title bar control, setting up event handlers, and configuring initial appearance based on device and build configuration.

methods.name: OnLoaded
methods.description: Event handler for when the control is loaded; registers event handlers for title bar and system theme changes, and sets initial properties.

methods.name: OnUnloaded
methods.description: Event handler for cleanup when the control is unloaded; unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: RootFrame_RequestedThemeChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the app's theme changes; updates title bar colors accordingly.

methods.name: CoreTitleBarIsVisibleChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the visibility of the core title bar.

methods.name: CoreTitleBarLayoutMetricsChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the layout metrics of the core title bar, adjusting height and padding.

methods.name: SetTitleBarVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the custom title bar based on current state and mode.

methods.name: SetTitleBarHeightAndPadding
methods.description: Adjusts the height and padding of the title bar based on system insets.

methods.name: ColorValuesChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to system color values, triggering a UI update.

methods.name: SetTitleBarControlColors
methods.description: Updates the title bar button colors based on current theme and accessibility settings.

methods.name: OnHighContrastChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in high contrast accessibility settings.

methods.name: OnWindowActivated
methods.description: Handles window activation state changes to update visual focus states.

methods.name: OnIsAlwaysOnTopModePropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the IsAlwaysOnTopMode property, updating visual states.

methods.name: AlwaysOnTopButton_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the AlwaysOnTop button click, raising the AlwaysOnTopClick event.
